hyperedges.description: Ivermectin discovery leading to 2015 Nobel Prize: Satoshi Omura and William C. Campbell collaborated to discover Ivermectin, derived from avermectin, winning the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine
Ivermectin anticancer molecular targets: inhibits Akt/mTOR, Wnt, YAP1, PAK1, KPNB1, P-glycoprotein, HSP27 phosphorylation, NS3 helicase; activates glutamate-gated chloride channels

Ivermectin clinical antiparasitic applications: treats onchocerciasis, lymphatic filariasis, strongyloidiasis, and scabies; outperforms diethylcarbamazine; Mectizan brand donated through Mectizan Donation Program

hyperedges.label: Anti-cancer drug mechanisms via pathway modulation
Mitohormesis ISR-OMA1-DELE1-ATF4 axis
hyperedges.relation: Mitochondrial stress activates OMA1 which cleaves DELE1; DELE1-S activates HRI which phosphorylates eIF2alpha inducing ATF4 — a convergent ISR activation cascade.

hyperedges.label: Quiescence G1 arrest via Rb-APC/C Cdh1-Skp2/p27 axis
hyperedges.relation: Hypophosphorylated Rb associates with APC/C Cdh1, which targets Skp2 and Geminin for degradation; Skp2 loss stabilizes p27; Geminin loss blocks MCM loading; Rb simultaneously represses E2F1 — a multi-layered G1 arrest circuit.

hyperedges.label: AGE-RAGE-NF-κB inflammatory cascade
hyperedges.relation: AGE-RAGE interaction triggers both NF-κB activation (driving TNFα and IL-6 transcription) and NAD(P)H oxidase activation (increasing intracellular oxidative stress) — a dual inflammatory and oxidative signaling cascade.

hyperedges.label: Epinephrine-to-Adrenochrome Oxidation Pathway
hyperedges.description: Complete oxidation pathway from Epinephrine to Adrenochrome via o-quinone and adrenaline-quinone intermediates, driven by ROS and catalyzed by Myeloperoxidase, with cyclization via intramolecular Michael addition

hyperedges.label: Adrenochrome Toxicity Mechanisms
hyperedges.description: Cluster of cardiotoxicity, hemolysis, mitochondrial dysfunction, and cell death pathways all caused by Adrenochrome via its electrophilic reactivity, redox cycling, and oxidative damage

hyperedges.label: Adrenochrome Senolytic and Glyco-oxidative Axis
hyperedges.description: Senotherapeutic and anti-glycation axis: Adrenochrome acts as senotherapeutic agent inducing senolysis and quiescence while modulating SASP and inhibiting NF-kB signaling; its derivative AMG contains Aminoguanidine which inhibits AGEs and traps dicarbonyl intermediates

hyperedges.name: Lysosome Biogenesis Core Processes
hyperedges.description: Lysosome biogenesis encompasses protein delivery, lysosome reformation, and transcriptional regulation as core sub-processes of lysosome formation and maintenance.

hyperedges.name: TFEB/TFE3 Transcriptional Activation of Lysosomal Gene Expression
hyperedges.description: TFEB and TFE3 bind CLEAR elements to activate lysosomal gene expression; this is regulated by mTOR phosphorylation (inhibitory), calcineurin dephosphorylation (activating), CDK4/CDK6 phosphorylation, CARM1 coactivation, and ZKSCAN3 repression.

hyperedges.name: MXL-3/HLH-30 Starvation Response and Lipophagy Network
hyperedges.description: Fasting triggers MXL-3 nuclear delocalization and HLH-30 nuclear translocation in C. elegans. HLH-30 (TFEB orthologue) induces lysosomal lipase genes (LIPL-1, LIPL-3) and autophagy genes, driving lipophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and starvation survival. MXL-3 (MAX orthologue) represses lysosomal lipase genes. Antagonistic regulation of lipid mobilization during nutrient stress.

hyperedges.label: TFEB/TFE3 phosphorylation regulatory network
hyperedges.description: Comprehensive kinase and phosphatase network regulating TFEB and TFE3 phosphorylation at specific serine residues, controlling subcellular localization and activity

hyperedges.label: TFEB expression and synthesis regulation
hyperedges.description: Regulators of TFEB at mRNA expression (PGC-1alpha, XBP1, MYC, SMAD3), RNA methylation (METTL3, ALKBH5), protein synthesis (Spermidine), and translation (PDCD4) levels

hyperedges.label: TFEB post-translational modifications, nuclear dynamics, and disease associations
hyperedges.description: Non-phosphorylation PTMs (acetylation, deacetylation, ubiquitylation, parsylation, glucosylation, oxidation, S-sulfhydration), 14-3-3 cytoplasmic retention, CRM1-mediated nuclear export, starvation/mitophagy/ER stress-induced nuclear translocation, and disease associations of TFEB dysregulation

nodes.description: 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-indole-5,6-dione; aminochrome undergoing redox cycling as potential mitohormetic longevity modulator

nodes.label: Mitohormesis
nodes.description: Principle that mild mitochondrial stress generates ROS signals activating adaptive defense programs enhancing cellular resilience

nodes.label: Redox Cycling
nodes.description: Catalytic process where adrenochrome is one-electron reduced to semiquinone radical then reoxidized by O2 generating superoxide

nodes.label: Nrf2/Keap1 Pathway
nodes.description: Master antioxidant response pathway; Nrf2 translocates to nucleus activating ARE-driven cytoprotective genes

nodes.label: Adrenochrome Monoaminoguanidine
nodes.description: Stabilized adrenochrome derivative combining indoline-dione core with aminoguanidine; dual glyco-oxidative modulator targeting AGEs and oxidative stress

nodes.label: Senomorphic Potential
nodes.description: Ability of adrenochrome and aminochromes to modulate senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP)

nodes.label: Mitophagy
nodes.description: Selective autophagy of damaged mitochondria triggered by adrenochrome-derived ROS via PGC-1alpha

nodes.label: PGC-1alpha
nodes.description: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma coactivator 1-alpha; master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis

nodes.label: Autophagy
nodes.description: Cellular degradation and recycling process for clearing proteostatic aggregates

nodes.label: Leuco-adrenochrome
nodes.description: Reduced form of adrenochrome; evaluated via MD simulations for lipid bilayer interaction stability

nodes.label: Neuromelanin
nodes.description: Polymerized aminochrome pigment in neurons; uncontrolled adrenochrome polymerization may promote neuroinflammation

nodes.label: Glutathione
nodes.description: Major endogenous antioxidant; NAC precursors explored to regulate adrenochrome polymerization rate

nodes.label: Cardiotoxicity
nodes.description: Primary risk of uncontrolled adrenochrome; mitigated via stabilized derivatives and targeted delivery

nodes.label: Hormesis
nodes.description: Biphasic dose-response where low doses are beneficial/stimulatory while high doses are toxic

nodes.label: Hormetic Window
nodes.description: Concentration range between eustress (adaptive) and distress (cytotoxic) responses for adrenochrome

nodes.label: MnSOD
nodes.description: Manganese superoxide dismutase (SOD2); mitochondrial matrix enzyme dismutating superoxide to H2O2; activated by SIRT3 deacetylation at K68/K122

nodes.label: SIRT3
nodes.description: Mitochondrial NAD+-dependent deacetylase; activates MnSOD via deacetylation; core longevity-associated sirtuin

nodes.label: SIRT4
nodes.description: Mitochondrial sirtuin; inhibits MnSOD via mono-ADP-ribosylation; opposes SIRT3 activity

nodes.label: SIRT3/SIRT4 Ratio
nodes.description: Determines mitochondrial superoxide handling kinetics; high ratio = protective quenching, low ratio = amplified oxidative damage

nodes.label: Redox Vaccination
nodes.description: Prior sub-lethal redox stress exposure protects against subsequent oxidative challenge through SIRT3-mediated MnSOD enhancement

nodes.label: Superoxide
nodes.description: O2- radical; primary signaling output of adrenochrome redox cycling; substrate for MnSOD

nodes.label: Hydrogen Peroxide
nodes.description: H2O2; product of MnSOD dismutation; diffuses to cytosol activating AMPK and NRF2

nodes.label: FOXO3a
nodes.description: Forkhead box O3a transcription factor; activated by ROS and SIRT1 deacetylation; upregulates SOD2 and catalase

nodes.label: AMPK
nodes.description: AMP-activated protein kinase; energy sensor activated by H2O2 from MnSOD reaction; promotes PGC-1alpha and SOD2 upregulation

nodes.label: NF-kappaB
nodes.description: Nuclear factor kappa B; transcriptionally upregulates MnSOD as negative feedback; deacetylated by SIRT1 for anti-inflammatory effect

nodes.label: NRF2
nodes.description: Nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2; master regulator of antioxidant response; activated by H2O2 diffusing to cytosol

nodes.label: Resveratrol
nodes.description: Polyphenol SIRT1 activator; activates AMPK via CaMKKbeta; chronic NAD+ elevation route to MnSOD enhancement

nodes.label: Honokiol
nodes.description: Natural compound; direct SIRT3 activator promoting MnSOD deacetylation; synergistic with adrenochrome redox cycling

nodes.label: Carbazochrome
nodes.description: Stabilized adrenochrome derivative; approved hemostatic agent; proposed for repurposing as hormetic preconditioning agent

nodes.label: NAD+
nodes.description: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide; essential cofactor for sirtuins; elevated by resveratrol/NMN/NR pathway

nodes.label: NMN
nodes.description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide; NAD+ precursor; fuels all sirtuins; synergistic with adrenochrome for MnSOD activation

nodes.label: Nicotinamide Riboside
nodes.description: NAD+ precursor (NR); boosts cellular NAD+ levels supporting all sirtuin activity

nodes.label: Respiratory Chain Complex I
nodes.description: NADH dehydrogenase; one-electron reduction site for adrenochrome; source of both baseline ETC superoxide leak and adrenochrome semiquinone generation

nodes.label: Adrenochrome Semiquinone Radical
nodes.description: One-electron reduced form of adrenochrome; transfers electron to O2 generating superoxide and regenerating parent compound

nodes.label: Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury
nodes.description: Tissue damage from blood supply restoration after ischemia; proposed clinical application for carbazochrome hormetic preconditioning

nodes.label: SIRT6
nodes.description: NAD+-dependent deacetylase; deacetylates H3K9ac/H3K56ac; master epigenetic gatekeeper for heterochromatin, telomere integrity, DNA repair

nodes.label: TFEB
nodes.description: Transcription factor EB; master regulator of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy; activated by adrenochrome via SIRT2-independent AMPK-mTOR-ULK1 axis

nodes.label: SIRT2
nodes.description: NAD+-dependent deacetylase; stabilizes TFEB mRNA but drives neurodegeneration via alpha-tubulin deacetylation

nodes.label: SIRT1
nodes.description: Nuclear/cytoplasmic NAD+-dependent deacetylase; deacetylates PGC-1alpha, FOXO3a, NF-kappaB; central longevity sirtuin

nodes.label: SIRT7
nodes.description: Nucleolar sirtuin; part of the SIRT1-SIRT7 deacetylase network

nodes.label: CD38
nodes.description: Primary NAD+ glycohydrolase/sink during aging; upregulated by NF-kappaB; target for ultra-low-dose daratumumab/isatuximab

nodes.label: NAMPT
nodes.description: Nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase; rate-limiting enzyme in NAD+ salvage pathway; induced by adrenochrome via SIRT1-dependent feedback

nodes.label: Daratumumab
nodes.description: Anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody; proposed ultra-low-dose repurposing for NAD+ preservation during aging

nodes.label: MDL-800
nodes.description: Synthetic allosteric SIRT6 activator; proposed combination with adrenochrome for supra-additive H3K9 deacetylation and DSB repair

nodes.label: UBCS039
nodes.description: Synthetic allosteric SIRT6 activator; opened translational avenues for epigenetic modulation

nodes.label: miR-217
nodes.description: Age-upregulated microRNA that suppresses SIRT1 translation; target for LNA antagomir therapy

nodes.label: miR-543
nodes.description: Age-upregulated microRNA suppressing SIRT1; candidate for adrenochrome-mediated transcriptional repression via Nrf2

nodes.label: miR-378
nodes.description: Age-upregulated microRNA suppressing SIRT1 translation; contributes to NF-kappaB-dependent SASP

nodes.label: LNA Antagomir
nodes.description: Locked nucleic acid antagomir; neutralizes mature miRNAs; proposed combination with adrenochrome for additive SIRT1 derepression

nodes.label: PARP1
nodes.description: Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase 1; consumes NAD+ at rates 10-100x higher than sirtuins upon DNA damage; activated by adrenochrome-derived ROS

nodes.label: NLRP3 Inflammasome
nodes.description: Pro-inflammatory caspase-1 activating complex; suppressed by adrenochrome via Nrf2-mediated NF-kappaB repression in microglia

nodes.label: H3K9ac
nodes.description: Histone H3 lysine 9 acetylation mark; deacetylated by SIRT6 for heterochromatin compaction; target of MDL-800 + adrenochrome combination

nodes.label: DNA Repair
nodes.description: Double-strand break repair; accelerated by SIRT6 activation via adrenochrome + MDL-800 combination

nodes.label: Epigenetic Clock
nodes.description: Horvath methylation-based biological age estimator; primary endpoint for in vivo adrenochrome longevity studies

nodes.label: SASP
nodes.description: Senescence-associated secretory phenotype; driven by NF-kappaB; suppressed by adrenochrome via SIRT1 derepression and Nrf2 activation

nodes.label: Autophagic Flux
nodes.description: Rate of autophagic degradation; enhanced by adrenochrome via SIRT2-independent TFEB activation; synergistic with SIRT2-stabilizing peptides

nodes.label: mTOR
nodes.description: Mechanistic target of rapamycin; inhibits TFEB nuclear translocation; suppressed by AMPK via TSC2 and Raptor phosphorylation

nodes.label: Nicotinamide Nucleotide Transhydrogenase
nodes.description: Mitochondrial inner membrane enzyme; hydride transfer linking NADPH/NADP+ ratio to NAD+/NADH ratio

nodes.label: Drosha/DGCR8 Microprocessor Complex
nodes.description: Pri-miRNA processing complex; potentially modified by adrenochrome electrophilic quinone moiety altering processing rates

nodes.label: Mitohormesis
nodes.description: A form of hormesis mediated by mitochondrial stress signaling, producing adaptive beneficial effects through mitohormetic pathways.

nodes.label: Hormesis
nodes.description: A biphasic dose-response phenomenon where low doses of a stressor induce beneficial adaptive responses.

nodes.label: Mitochondrial stress
nodes.description: Stress conditions affecting mitochondrial function, triggering multiple adaptive signaling cascades including ISR, OMA1-DELE1-HRI pathway, and ATFS-1 nuclear translocation.

nodes.label: Integrated Stress Response
nodes.description: A conserved stress response pathway activated by eIF2alpha phosphorylation, leading to translational reprogramming via ATF4 induction.

nodes.label: OMA1
nodes.description: A zinc metalloprotease in the inner mitochondrial membrane that cleaves DELE1 during mitochondrial stress.

nodes.label: DELE1
nodes.description: An inner mitochondrial membrane protein that, upon OMA1 cleavage, generates a short isoform (DELE1-S) that translocates to the cytosol to activate the ISR via HRI.

nodes.label: DELE1-S
nodes.description: Short isoform of DELE1 generated by OMA1 cleavage; accumulates in the cytosol where it binds and activates HRI.

nodes.label: HRI
nodes.description: Heme-regulated inhibitor kinase, a eIF2alpha kinase activated by DELE1-S during mitochondrial stress, phosphorylating eIF2alpha to trigger the ISR.

nodes.label: eIF2alpha
nodes.description: Eukaryotic initiation factor 2 alpha subunit; when phosphorylated by HRI, it triggers translational attenuation and ATF4 upregulation as part of the ISR.

nodes.label: Phosphorylation of eIF2alpha
nodes.description: Post-translational modification of eIF2alpha that reduces global translation while selectively upregulating ATF4 and other stress-response genes.

nodes.label: ATF4
nodes.description: Activating transcription factor 4; a master transcriptional regulator induced by eIF2alpha phosphorylation that drives serine biosynthesis, transsulfuration, and amino acid response genes.

nodes.label: Amino Acid Response Element
nodes.description: DNA cis-regulatory element bound by ATF4 to activate genes involved in amino acid metabolism and stress adaptation.

nodes.label: Serine biosynthesis
nodes.description: De novo serine synthesis pathway upregulated by ATF4 to support one-carbon metabolism and redox homeostasis during stress.

nodes.label: Transsulfuration
nodes.description: Metabolic pathway converting homocysteine to cysteine, upregulated by ATF4 to support glutathione synthesis and redox balance.

nodes.label: DELE1-L
nodes.description: Full-length DELE1 isoform that accumulates on the outer mitochondrial membrane under conditions like iron deficiency.

nodes.label: Outer mitochondrial membrane
nodes.description: The outer boundary membrane of mitochondria where DELE1-L accumulates during iron deficiency stress.

nodes.label: Iron deficiency
nodes.description: A nutritional stress state that triggers DELE1-L accumulation on the outer mitochondrial membrane.

nodes.label: DELE1-L accumulation
nodes.description: Accumulation of full-length DELE1 on the outer mitochondrial membrane, triggered by iron deficiency.

nodes.label: ATF5
nodes.description: Activating transcription factor 5 that mediates the mammalian mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt).

nodes.label: Mammalian Mitochondrial UPR
nodes.description: The mammalian mitochondrial unfolded protein response, a protective signaling pathway mediated by ATF5 to restore mitochondrial proteostasis.

nodes.label: ATFS-1
nodes.description: Activating transcription factor associated with stress-1; the C. elegans transcription factor that regulates UPRmt and traffics to the nucleus during mitochondrial stress.

nodes.label: UPRmt
nodes.description: Mitochondrial unfolded protein response; a conserved stress response that upregulates mitochondrial chaperones and proteases to maintain proteostasis.

nodes.label: Nucleus
nodes.description: The cellular organelle where ATFS-1 traffics to activate UPRmt gene transcription.

nodes.label: ATFS-1 nuclear translocation
nodes.description: The process by which ATFS-1 moves from the cytosol to the nucleus during mitochondrial stress to activate UPRmt gene expression.

nodes.label: Lon Protease
nodes.description: An ATP-dependent mitochondrial matrix protease that degrades ATFS-1 under basal conditions, keeping UPRmt inactive.

nodes.label: Mitochondrial dysfunction
nodes.description: Impaired mitochondrial function that disrupts PINK1 stabilization and activates mitophagy pathways.

nodes.label: PINK1
nodes.description: PTEN-induced kinase 1; a mitochondrial kinase that accumulates on damaged mitochondria and recruits Parkin to initiate mitophagy.

nodes.label: Parkin-dependent Mitophagy
nodes.description: The PINK1/Parkin-mediated selective autophagy pathway for clearing damaged mitochondria.

nodes.description: Ubiquilin; a ubiquitin-like protein that binds mitochondrial membrane proteins and prevents protein aggregation during mitochondrial stress.

nodes.label: Mitochondrial membrane proteins
nodes.description: Proteins embedded in mitochondrial membranes that are bound by UBQLN and subject to quality control.

nodes.label: Protein aggregation
nodes.description: The pathological clumping of misfolded proteins; prevented by UBQLN during mitochondrial membrane protein stress.

nodes.label: Ubx2
nodes.description: A membrane-anchored adaptor that associates with the TOM complex and recruits Cdc48 for extraction of stalled proteins.

nodes.label: TOM complex
nodes.description: Translocase of the outer mitochondrial membrane; the protein import machinery with which Ubx2 associates.

nodes.label: Cdc48
nodes.description: A AAA+ ATPase (p97/VCP homolog) recruited by Ubx2 to extract stalled proteins from the mitochondrial membrane for degradation.

nodes.label: Stalled proteins
nodes.description: Misfolded or stalled proteins at the TOM complex that are extracted by Cdc48 for quality control.

nodes.label: PDR3
nodes.description: A yeast transcription factor that induces Cis1 expression as part of the mitoprotein-induced stress response.

nodes.label: Cis1
nodes.description: A stress-induced protein that recruits Msp1 to the mitochondrial outer membrane for quality control of mistargeted tail-anchored proteins.

nodes.label: Msp1
nodes.description: An AAA+ ATPase that extracts mistargeted tail-anchored (TA) proteins from the mitochondrial outer membrane.

nodes.label: Mistargeted TA proteins
nodes.description: Tail-anchored proteins incorrectly targeted to the mitochondrial outer membrane; substrates for Msp1 extraction.

nodes.label: Vms1
nodes.description: A mitochondrial quality control protein that links mitochondrial stress to ribosome quality control pathways.

nodes.label: Ribosome quality control
nodes.description: A cellular surveillance mechanism that detects and degrades aberrant ribosome-associated proteins, linked to mitochondrial stress via Vms1.

nodes.label: Mitoprotein-Induced Stress Response
nodes.description: A proteostasis network orchestrated by HSF1 that responds to accumulation of mistargeted mitochondrial proteins.

nodes.label: HSF1
nodes.description: Heat shock factor 1; a master transcription factor that orchestrates the mitoprotein-induced stress response and activates RPN4.

nodes.label: RPN4
nodes.description: A transcription factor that induces proteasome subunit genes in response to protein stress, activated by HSF1.

nodes.label: Proteasome subunits
nodes.description: Components of the 26S proteasome induced by RPN4 to enhance protein degradation capacity during stress.

nodes.label: Cytosol
nodes.description: The cytoplasmic compartment where DELE1-S accumulates to activate HRI and the ISR.

nodes.label: GDF15
nodes.description: Growth differentiation factor 15; a mitokine and myokine secreted in response to mitochondrial stress, regulates body fat mass and energy homeostasis.

nodes.label: Mitokine
nodes.description: Mitochondria-derived signaling molecules secreted to communicate mitochondrial stress status to other cells and tissues.

nodes.label: Myokine
nodes.description: Muscle-derived cytokines or signaling molecules; GDF15 acts as a myokine during mitochondrial stress in muscle.

nodes.label: Body fat mass
nodes.description: Adipose tissue mass regulated by GDF15 signaling from mitochondrially stressed tissues.

nodes.label: Metformin
nodes.description: A biguanide drug that induces mitochondrial stress by inhibiting Complex I, leading to GDF15 secretion and other mitohormetic effects.

nodes.label: Complex I
nodes.description: NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase; the first complex of the mitochondrial electron transport chain, inhibited by metformin.

nodes.label: FGF21
nodes.description: Fibroblast growth factor 21; a hepatokine/mitokine secreted in response to mitochondrial stress via the OMA1-DELE1-ATF4 pathway.

nodes.label: FGF21 secretion
nodes.description: The release of FGF21 from hepatocytes, occurring downstream of the OMA1-DELE1-ATF4 mitochondrial stress pathway.

nodes.label: OMA1-DELE1-ATF4 pathway
nodes.description: A mitochondrial stress signaling cascade: OMA1 cleaves DELE1, DELE1-S activates HRI, which phosphorylates eIF2alpha, inducing ATF4 and downstream FGF21 secretion.

nodes.label: MOTS-c
nodes.description: Mitochondrial open reading frame of the 12S rRNA-c; a mitochondria-derived peptide encoded in the 12S rRNA gene with metabolic regulatory functions.

nodes.label: Mitochondrial 12S rRNA
nodes.description: The mitochondrial ribosomal RNA gene that also encodes the MOTS-c peptide.

nodes.label: Quiescence
nodes.description: A reversible state of proliferative arrest in which cells exit the cell cycle but retain the capacity to re-enter upon stimulation.

nodes.label: reversible proliferative arrest
nodes.description: The defining characteristic of quiescence: cells cease division but can resume proliferation when conditions permit.

nodes.label: Quiescent cells
nodes.description: Cells in a dormant G0 state that retain the ability to re-enter the cell cycle.

nodes.label: Cyclin D-CDK4/6
nodes.description: Cyclin-dependent kinase 4/6 paired with Cyclin D; the key kinase complex that promotes G1 progression and cell cycle entry.

nodes.label: G1 progression
nodes.description: Movement through the G1 phase of the cell cycle, promoted by Cyclin D-CDK4/6 activity.

nodes.label: CDK inhibitors
nodes.description: A family of proteins (p21, p27) that inhibit cyclin-CDK complexes to enforce cell cycle arrest and promote quiescence.

nodes.label: p21 (CDKN1A)
nodes.description: Cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 1A; a CIP/KIP family CDK inhibitor that enforces G1 arrest and quiescence.

nodes.label: p27 (CDKN1B)
nodes.description: Cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 1B; a CIP/KIP family CDK inhibitor that maintains quiescence by inhibiting Cyclin E-CDK2.

nodes.label: CDK inhibitor
nodes.description: A functional category for proteins that inhibit cyclin-dependent kinases to enforce cell cycle arrest.

nodes.label: Retinoblastoma protein (Rb)
nodes.description: A tumor suppressor protein that inhibits proliferation by sequestering E2F transcription factors when hypophosphorylated.

nodes.label: E2F1
nodes.description: A transcription factor that drives S-phase entry; inactivated by Rb binding in quiescent cells.

nodes.label: Phosphorylation of Rb
nodes.description: CDK-mediated phosphorylation of Rb that releases E2F, preventing E2F repression and allowing cell cycle progression.

nodes.label: repression of E2F
nodes.description: The inhibition of E2F transcription factor activity by hypophosphorylated Rb, maintaining G1 arrest.

nodes.label: Hypophosphorylated Rb
nodes.description: The active, growth-suppressive form of Rb that associates with APC/C Cdh1 and represses E2F target genes.

nodes.label: APC/C Cdh1
nodes.description: Anaphase-promoting complex/cyclosome with Cdh1 activator; an E3 ubiquitin ligase active in G0 that targets cell cycle regulators for degradation.

nodes.label: Skp2
nodes.description: S-phase kinase-associated protein 2; an F-box protein that targets p27 for degradation, negatively regulating quiescence.

nodes.label: Geminin
nodes.description: A DNA replication inhibitor targeted by APC/C Cdh1 for degradation in G0; also blocks MCM loading to prevent re-replication.

nodes.label: MCM loading
nodes.description: Loading of minichromosome maintenance helicase complexes onto replication origins; blocked by Geminin in quiescent cells.

nodes.label: TGF-beta1
nodes.description: Transforming growth factor beta 1; a cytokine that promotes quiescence through CDK inhibitor induction.

nodes.label: Wnt4
nodes.description: A Wnt family ligand that promotes quiescence in certain cell types.

nodes.label: DNA replication stress
nodes.description: Damage or stalled replication forks that trigger cell cycle arrest and quiescence entry.

nodes.label: miR-489
nodes.description: A microRNA that reinforces quiescence by targeting proliferation-associated mRNAs.

nodes.label: ZFP36L
nodes.description: Zinc finger protein 36 C3H1-like; an RNA-binding protein that promotes cell quiescence by destabilizing proliferation mRNAs.

nodes.label: Intron retention
nodes.description: A form of alternative splicing enriched in quiescent adult stem cells that contributes to maintaining the quiescent state.

nodes.label: quiescent adult stem cells
nodes.description: Dormant adult stem cells in G0 that exhibit enriched intron retention and are maintained in a quiescent state.

nodes.label: Mitophagy
nodes.description: Selective autophagy of mitochondria; maintains quiescence by regulating mitochondrial content and signaling.

nodes.label: Phosphorylation of eIF2alpha
nodes.description: eIF2alpha phosphorylation that regulates muscle stem cell quiescence through translational control.

nodes.label: muscle stem cell quiescence
nodes.description: The quiescent state of muscle satellite cells, regulated in part by eIF2alpha phosphorylation-mediated translational control.

nodes.label: Primary cilium
nodes.description: A microtubule-based sensory organelle that assembles in quiescent cells and regulates signaling pathways.

nodes.label: CENP-A deposition
nodes.description: Incorporation of the histone H3 variant CENP-A at centromeres, maintained during quiescence to preserve centromere identity.

nodes.label: centromere identity
nodes.description: The epigenetic specification of centromeric chromatin maintained by CENP-A deposition during quiescence.

nodes.label: Cohesin loss
nodes.description: Loss of the cohesin complex that can cause meiotic segregation errors.

nodes.label: meiotic segregation errors
nodes.description: Errors in chromosome segregation during meiosis caused by cohesin loss.

nodes.label: Quiescent cancer cells
nodes.description: Tumor cells in a dormant quiescent state that are resistant to chemotherapies targeting proliferating cells.

nodes.label: chemotherapies
nodes.description: Cancer treatments to which quiescent cancer cells exhibit resistance due to their non-proliferative state.

nodes.label: Advanced glycation end products
nodes.description: Heterogeneous group of molecules formed by non-enzymatic glycation (Maillard reaction) of proteins, lipids, and nucleic acids; accumulate with age and contribute to multiple age-related pathologies.

nodes.label: Maillard reaction
nodes.description: Non-enzymatic chemical reaction between reducing sugars and amino acids that produces AGEs.

nodes.label: reducing sugar and amino acids
nodes.description: Reactants in the Maillard reaction that form AGEs through non-enzymatic glycation.

nodes.label: Schiff base
nodes.description: An intermediate in the Maillard reaction formed from glucose and free amino acids, which rearranges to Amadori products.

nodes.label: glucose and free amino acid
nodes.description: The initial reactants that form a Schiff base in the early Maillard reaction.

nodes.label: Amadori products
nodes.description: Early glycation products formed by rearrangement of Schiff bases; precursors to AGEs.

nodes.label: early glycation products
nodes.description: Amadori products and related early-stage glycation intermediates that are reversible precursors to AGEs.

nodes.label: AGEs
nodes.description: Advanced glycation end products; stable, irreversible modifications that accumulate in tissues and drive aging pathologies.

nodes.label: extracellular matrix
nodes.description: The structural network of proteins and carbohydrates outside cells where AGEs accumulate and cause cross-linking and stiffness.

nodes.label: Alzheimer's disease
nodes.description: A neurodegenerative disease associated with AGE accumulation in the brain.

nodes.label: arterial stiffness
nodes.description: Loss of arterial elasticity caused by AGE-mediated cross-linking of extracellular matrix collagen and elastin.

nodes.label: NO synthase activity
nodes.description: Nitric oxide synthase activity reduced by AGEs, contributing to endothelial dysfunction.

nodes.label: sarcopenia
nodes.description: Age-related loss of muscle mass and function contributed to by AGE accumulation.

nodes.label: AGE-RAGE interaction
nodes.description: Binding of AGEs to the receptor for AGEs (RAGE), triggering inflammatory and oxidative signaling cascades.

nodes.label: NF-κB activation
nodes.description: Activation of the NF-κB transcription factor by AGE-RAGE signaling, driving pro-inflammatory gene expression.

nodes.label: NAD(P)H oxidase
nodes.description: An enzyme activated by AGE-RAGE signaling that generates reactive oxygen species, increasing intracellular oxidative stress.

nodes.label: NF-κB
nodes.description: Nuclear factor kappa B; a master transcription factor for inflammatory responses activated by AGE-RAGE signaling.

nodes.label: TNFα
nodes.description: Tumor necrosis factor alpha; a pro-inflammatory cytokine whose transcription is activated by NF-κB downstream of AGE-RAGE.

nodes.label: IL-6
nodes.description: Interleukin 6; a pleiotropic cytokine whose transcription is activated by NF-κB downstream of AGE-RAGE signaling.

nodes.label: intracellular oxidative stress
nodes.description: Reactive oxygen species accumulation within cells, increased by NAD(P)H oxidase activated via AGE-RAGE.

nodes.label: Glycated LDL
nodes.description: Low-density lipoprotein modified by glycation, leading to foam cell formation and atherosclerosis.

nodes.label: foam cell formation
nodes.description: Macrophage engulfment of glycated LDL leading to lipid-laden foam cells, a hallmark of atherosclerotic plaque.

nodes.label: Aminoguanidine
nodes.description: An AGE formation inhibitor that prevents age-related cardiac hypertrophy.

nodes.label: age-related cardiac hypertrophy
nodes.description: Pathological enlargement of the heart with age, prevented by aminoguanidine via AGE inhibition.

nodes.label: CML
nodes.description: Carboxymethyllysine; a major AGE biomarker that predicts cardiovascular mortality and is associated with chronic kidney disease.

nodes.label: cardiovascular mortality
nodes.description: Death from cardiovascular causes, predicted by elevated CML levels.

nodes.label: chronic kidney disease
nodes.description: A progressive loss of kidney function associated with elevated CML and AGE accumulation.

nodes.label: Dietary AGEs
nodes.description: AGEs absorbed from the diet that contribute to the total body AGE pool.

nodes.label: body AGE pool
nodes.description: The total accumulated AGE burden in the body, contributed to by both endogenous formation and dietary intake.

nodes.label: Pyrraline
nodes.description: An AGE amino acid derivative absorbed by the intestinal transporter hPEPT1.

nodes.label: hPEPT1
nodes.description: Human peptide transporter 1; an intestinal proton-coupled peptide transporter that absorbs dietary AGEs such as pyrraline.

nodes.label: Caloric restriction
nodes.description: Reduced caloric intake without malnutrition; increases lifespan and reduces AGE accumulation.

nodes.label: lifespan
nodes.description: Maximum or average lifespan, increased by caloric restriction.

nodes.label: Exercise
nodes.description: Physical activity that reduces circulating AGE levels.

nodes.label: circulating AGEs
nodes.description: AGEs present in the bloodstream; reduced by exercise and metformin.

nodes.label: Metformin
nodes.description: A biguanide antidiabetic drug that decreases circulating AGE levels.

nodes.label: Orlistat
nodes.description: A lipase inhibitor that reduces AGEs absorption from the diet.

nodes.label: AGEs absorption
nodes.description: Intestinal absorption of dietary AGEs; reduced by orlistat.

hyperedges.label: miRNA-SIRT1-NF-kB SASP Regulatory Circuit
hyperedges.relation: Age-upregulated miRNAs suppress SIRT1 leading to NF-kB hyperacetylation and sustained SASP; adrenochrome + LNA antagomirs derepress this circuit

hyperedges.label: SIRT3-SIRT4-MnSOD Mitochondrial Redox Rheostat

hyperedges.description: Ivermectin discovery leading to 2015 Nobel Prize: Satoshi Omura and William C. Campbell collaborated to discover Ivermectin, derived from avermectin, winning the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine
Ivermectin anticancer molecular targets: inhibits Akt/mTOR, Wnt, YAP1, PAK1, KPNB1, P-glycoprotein, HSP27 phosphorylation, NS3 helicase; activates glutamate-gated chloride channels

Ivermectin clinical antiparasitic applications: treats onchocerciasis, lymphatic filariasis, strongyloidiasis, and scabies; outperforms diethylcarbamazine; Mectizan brand donated through Mectizan Donation Program

hyperedges.label: Anti-cancer drug mechanisms via pathway modulation
Mitohormesis ISR-OMA1-DELE1-ATF4 axis
hyperedges.relation: Mitochondrial stress activates OMA1 which cleaves DELE1; DELE1-S activates HRI which phosphorylates eIF2alpha inducing ATF4 — a convergent ISR activation cascade.

hyperedges.label: Quiescence G1 arrest via Rb-APC/C Cdh1-Skp2/p27 axis
hyperedges.relation: Hypophosphorylated Rb associates with APC/C Cdh1, which targets Skp2 and Geminin for degradation; Skp2 loss stabilizes p27; Geminin loss blocks MCM loading; Rb simultaneously represses E2F1 — a multi-layered G1 arrest circuit.

hyperedges.label: AGE-RAGE-NF-κB inflammatory cascade
hyperedges.relation: AGE-RAGE interaction triggers both NF-κB activation (driving TNFα and IL-6 transcription) and NAD(P)H oxidase activation (increasing intracellular oxidative stress) — a dual inflammatory and oxidative signaling cascade.

hyperedges.label: Epinephrine-to-Adrenochrome Oxidation Pathway
hyperedges.description: Complete oxidation pathway from Epinephrine to Adrenochrome via o-quinone and adrenaline-quinone intermediates, driven by ROS and catalyzed by Myeloperoxidase, with cyclization via intramolecular Michael addition

hyperedges.label: Adrenochrome Toxicity Mechanisms
hyperedges.description: Cluster of cardiotoxicity, hemolysis, mitochondrial dysfunction, and cell death pathways all caused by Adrenochrome via its electrophilic reactivity, redox cycling, and oxidative damage

hyperedges.label: Adrenochrome Senolytic and Glyco-oxidative Axis
hyperedges.description: Senotherapeutic and anti-glycation axis: Adrenochrome acts as senotherapeutic agent inducing senolysis and quiescence while modulating SASP and inhibiting NF-kB signaling; its derivative AMG contains Aminoguanidine which inhibits AGEs and traps dicarbonyl intermediates

hyperedges.label: Ivermectin synergizes with multiple anticancer drugs

hyperedges.name: Lysosome Biogenesis Core Processes
hyperedges.description: Lysosome biogenesis encompasses protein delivery, lysosome reformation, and transcriptional regulation as core sub-processes of lysosome formation and maintenance.

hyperedges.name: TFEB/TFE3 Transcriptional Activation of Lysosomal Gene Expression
hyperedges.description: TFEB and TFE3 bind CLEAR elements to activate lysosomal gene expression; this is regulated by mTOR phosphorylation (inhibitory), calcineurin dephosphorylation (activating), CDK4/CDK6 phosphorylation, CARM1 coactivation, and ZKSCAN3 repression.

hyperedges.name: MXL-3/HLH-30 Starvation Response and Lipophagy Network
hyperedges.description: Fasting triggers MXL-3 nuclear delocalization and HLH-30 nuclear translocation in C. elegans. HLH-30 (TFEB orthologue) induces lysosomal lipase genes (LIPL-1, LIPL-3) and autophagy genes, driving lipophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and starvation survival. MXL-3 (MAX orthologue) represses lysosomal lipase genes. Antagonistic regulation of lipid mobilization during nutrient stress.

hyperedges.label: TFEB/TFE3 phosphorylation regulatory network
hyperedges.description: Comprehensive kinase and phosphatase network regulating TFEB and TFE3 phosphorylation at specific serine residues, controlling subcellular localization and activity

hyperedges.label: TFEB expression and synthesis regulation
hyperedges.description: Regulators of TFEB at mRNA expression (PGC-1alpha, XBP1, MYC, SMAD3), RNA methylation (METTL3, ALKBH5), protein synthesis (Spermidine), and translation (PDCD4) levels

hyperedges.label: TFEB post-translational modifications, nuclear dynamics, and disease associations
hyperedges.description: Non-phosphorylation PTMs (acetylation, deacetylation, ubiquitylation, parsylation, glucosylation, oxidation, S-sulfhydration), 14-3-3 cytoplasmic retention, CRM1-mediated nuclear export, starvation/mitophagy/ER stress-induced nuclear translocation, and disease associations of TFEB dysregulation
